item.title: Let's Go Do This: Texas Cuts Red Tape on ‘Cottage Food Industry’
item.description: Texas has updated its cottage food law, raising the annual revenue cap to $150,000 and simplifying labeling requirements — making it easier than ever to turn a home kitchen into a legitimate food business without costly red tape.

item.title: P53 Forges American-Made Golf Irons in Fort Worth, Inspired by Ben Hogan
item.description: Late to golf but captivated by its beauty and history, Christopher Griffin built a Fort Worth company forging irons from certified U.S. steel — blending American manufacturing with a tribute to Ben Hogan’s 1953 season.

item.title: Fort Worth-Based Coltala Holdings Co-Founder Named to Inaugural NYSE Texas Advisory Board
item.description: The Coltala Holdings co-founder joins the founding advisory board as NYSE Texas celebrates a big first year.

item.title: 'Fort Worth Inc.' Celebrates 2026 40 Under 40 Honorees at River Ranch Stockyards
item.description: Mayor Mattie Parker and Mike Moncrief joined Fort Worth Inc. in honoring the 2026 40 Under 40 class at River Ranch Stockyards. Who is in this year's cohort? Find our here.

item.title: How the One Big Beautiful Bill Act Reshapes Charitable Tax Deductions
item.description: New AGI floors, above-the-line deductions, and corporate contribution limits under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act are set to significantly reshape charitable tax planning beginning in 2026.

item.title: U.S. Energy Development Plans $1 Billion Deployment in 2026, Expands Permian Focus
item.description: Fort Worth-based U.S. Energy Development Corporation plans to deploy up to $1 billion in 2026, concentrating new investment in the Permian Basin while emphasizing disciplined capital allocation, the company says.

item.title: Why Business Advocacy Still Matters to Business Leaders
item.description: As Fort Worth grows more complex, the Chamber’s role as convener and advocate becomes not optional — but essential, says Fort Worth Chamber CEO Steve Montgomery.

item.title: TCU Online Criminal Justice Program Ranks No. 3 Nationally
item.description: TCU’s online criminology and criminal justice master’s program climbs three spots in the 2026 U.S. News & World Report rankings.

item.title: Perot Jr., Mike Berry Named 'Fort Worth Inc.' Persons of the Year
item.description: Hillwood leaders Ross Perot Jr. and Mike Berry are recognized for transforming AllianceTexas into one of the nation’s most powerful economic engines and positioning Fort Worth as a global logistics and innovation hub.

item.title: John Cornyn, Fort Worth Allies Take Aim at Ken Paxton
item.description: As early voting begins, Sen. John Cornyn and friends, including Charlie Geren, deliver a blunt warning about Ken Paxton’s record while leaning on character, law enforcement endorsements, and a massive fundraising edge.
